bin_edge_extraction_method: GRAPHICAL ESTIMATE, not exact -- paper gives no numeric bin count/edges anywhere in text. Visual step-counting on the Pileup (green) curve (most bins clearly visible across the widest range, ~4e-3 to ~7e-2 cm) suggests approximately 20 log-spaced bins across the full 2-decade x-axis range (1e-3 to 1e-1 cm for Delta_s; 1e-2 to 1e0 cm for Delta_w) -- consistent with, not independently more precise than, the 20-bin log-spacing already used in this project earlier Fig.5 reproductions.
axis_calibration_note: Not pixel-calibrated to sub-bin precision in this pass; a dedicated digitizer (e.g. WebPlotDigitizer-style click calibration on the 10^-3/10^-2/10^-1 gridlines) would be required for exact bin-edge recovery, and was judged not to change any conclusion in this audit (which concerns NORMALIZATION, not bin placement).
